releases.title: JEFFREY STEELE TO BE HONORED WITH BMI ICON AWARD AT THE 74TH ANNUAL BMI COUNTRY AWARDS ON NOV. 17TH
releases.body:
Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year to be Revealed During Celebration of  the Year's 50 Most-Performed Country Songs

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BMI will celebrate one of the ultimate architects of modern Country music, Jeffrey Steele, by naming him a BMI Icon during the 74th annual BMI Country Awards. The two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year will be recognized for his significant songwriting and contributions to Country music. The invitation-only event will be held at BMI's Nashville office on Nov. 17th and will be hosted by BMI's CEO, Mike O'Neill, Executive Vice President, Chief Revenue & Creative Officer, Mike Steinberg and BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley.

Throughout the evening, BMI will also reveal the Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year, while celebrating the top songwriters and music publishers behind this past year's 50 most-performed songs in Country music.

"Jeffrey Steele is a titan of modern storytelling whose catalog has shaped the sound of Country music over the last three decades," BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley said. "When you hear one of his anthems that has become the soundtrack to millions of lives, you can feel the emotion behind every lyric. As a two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year and an intentional mentor to the next generation of creators, Steele has earned a permanent place among the greats."

Since Steele's affiliation with BMI in 1981, the multi-Platinum songwriter, singer and producer has shaped the modern Country music landscape with over 60 chart-topping hits. The prolific songwriter has received more than 34 BMI Country and Pop Awards for his extensive catalog that includes iconic songs like Tim McGraw's "The Cowboy in Me" along with Rascal Flatts' "What Hurts the Most," "My Wish," and "These Days" as well as Keith Urban's "Raise 'Em Up" featuring Eric Church, Zac Brown Band's "Knee Deep," Van Zant's "Help Somebody," Montgomery Gentry's "Something to Be Proud Of" and "My Town." The seven-time GRAMMY® nominee has earned critical recognition for his creative impact with an induction into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, and Steele has been honored by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet."

The BMI Icon Award is given to exceptional songwriters in recognition of their unique and indelible influence on music makers over many generations. In receiving this award, Steele joins an impressive list of Country legends including Bill Anderson, Matraca Berg, Clint Black, Toby Keith, Loretta Lynn, Willie Nelson, Merle Haggard, Dolly Parton, Kris Kristofferson, Dean Dillon, Vince Gill and Hank Williams, Jr., as well as multi-genre creative/songwriting royalty Stevie Nicks, Little Richard, Carole King, Patti LaBelle, Brian Wilson, James Brown, Janet Jackson, Bo Diddley, Holland-Dozier-Holland, Peter Gabriel, Al Green, Van Morrison, Sting, Bryan Ferry, Carlos Santana, Los Lobos, and more.

ABOUT JEFFREY STEELE:

Jeffrey Steele continues to shape American music with songs that connect people across generations. With more than 65 million radio and television airplays, his songwriting has produced major hits for artists including Keith Urban, Eric Church, Zac Brown Band, Jimmy Buffett, Montgomery Gentry, Lynyrd Skynyrd, Cher, .38 Special, Faith Hill, Tim McGraw, Trace Adkins, LeAnn Rimes, Rascal Flatts, Van Zant, Joe Cocker, Little Feat ft. Bob Seger, Joe Bonamassa, Cascada, and many more. A member of the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, Steele has been recognized by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet," named BMI Songwriter of the Year twice, and awarded NSAI Songwriter of the Year three times. He is also a two-time CMA Triple Play Award recipient for penning three No. 1 hits in a single year. His extensive list of chart-topping songs includes: "Raise 'Em Up," "Knee Deep," "Here," "My Wish," "The Cowboy in Me," "These Days," "My Town," "Something to Be Proud Of," "Everyday," and the landmark "What Hurts the Most," which earned a GRAMMY® nomination for Best Country Song. Steele has received a Golden Globe and Critics' Choice nominee for Best Original Song for "I Thought I Lost You" (from Disney/Pixar's Bolt). He has been named one of Billboard's Top 5 Writers for eight consecutive years and MusicRow Magazine's Songwriter of the Year. Continuing to use his voice to reflect the times, Steele released his new single "A Voice" in January - a song rooted in hope, unity and shared humanity. Written as a reminder of what connects us in a world often marked by division and uncertainty, the song underscores Steele's enduring belief in music as a force for healing and togetherness. The song debuted at #4 on the Billboard Digital Sales charts. A full-length American Storyteller album of new music will follow. Fore more information visit www.JeffreySteele.com.

ABOUT BMI:

Celebrating over 80 years of service to songwriters, composers, music publishers and businesses, BMI® is a global leader in music rights management, serving as an advocate for the value of music. BMI represents the public performance rights in over 25 million musical works created and owned by more than 1.5 million songwriters, composers, and music publishers. The Company negotiates music license agreements and distributes the fees it generates as royalties to its affiliated writers and publishers when their songs are performed in public. In 1939, BMI created a groundbreaking open-door policy becoming the only performing rights organization to welcome and represent the creators of blues, jazz, country, and American roots music. Today, the musical compositions in BMI's repertoire, from chart toppers to perennial favorites, span all genres of music and are consistently among the most-performed hits of the year. For additional information and the latest BMI news, visit bmi.com, follow us on X, TikTok, and Instagram @BMI or stay connected through BMI's Facebook page. Sign up for BMI's The Weekly™ and receive our e-newsletter every week to stay up to date on all things music.

releases.title: Great American Media Names Harry Lang Senior Vice President of Product
releases.body:
Veteran streaming executive to lead product vision and strategy for Great American Pure Flix and GFam+

NEW YORK, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great American Media announced that Harry Lang has joined the company as Senior Vice President of Product. Lang will lead product strategy and development for the company's subscription streaming services, Great American Pure Flix and GFam+, with responsibility for enhancing the viewer experience and supporting the continued growth of both platforms.

Great American Media welcomes Harry Lang as SVP of Product, leading strategy and growth for Pure Flix and GFAM+.

"Harry understands how to build streaming products that serve audiences well and create lasting engagement," said Kaitlyn Haubrich, Chief of Staff and Chief Brand Officer for Great American Media. "His experience, technical knowledge and strong understanding of the consumer will be valuable as we continue investing in Great American Pure Flix and GFam+. We are pleased to welcome Harry to the team and look forward to his leadership as we strengthen the experience we provide our viewers."

"Great American Media has a clear purpose, a loyal audience and an exciting opportunity for continued growth," said Lang. "I look forward to working with Bill, Kaitlyn and the entire leadership team to make it easier for viewers to discover the programming they love, deepen their engagement with our services and ensure the product experience reflects the trust audiences have placed in the Great American Media brand."

Lang is an experienced product executive who has led strategy, development and execution across major streaming and entertainment platforms. Throughout his career, he has worked closely with engineering, design, data and marketing teams to develop consumer products for audiences at scale. He also brings experience incorporating emerging technologies and AI-assisted development into the product development process.

Lang spent 14 years at Paramount Pictures in the company's interactive and global games division before joining Hallmark Media, where he served for six years as Vice President of Product and led product development for the company's direct-to-consumer streaming service. He later returned to Paramount, most recently overseeing product for Paramount-owned Pluto TV.

In his new role, Lang will work closely with Great American Media's leadership and technology teams to improve content discovery, strengthen audience engagement and advance the streaming experience across Great American Pure Flix and GFam+.

Great American Media is home to a portfolio of family and faith-based entertainment brands, including Great American Family, Great American Faith & Living, Great American Pure Flix and GFam+. The company continues to expand its original programming, live events and subscription streaming offerings, providing audiences with entertainment that celebrates faith, family and country.

ABOUT GREAT AMERICAN MEDIA

Great American Media is the leader in faith and family entertainment, and one of the fastest-growing entertainment networks on television. Great American Media is home to a portfolio of entertainment brands that celebrate faith, family, and country, including Great American Family, the flagship linear network featuring original Christmas movies, rom-coms, and beloved series; Great American Pure Flix, the leading faith and family streaming service; Great American Faith & Living, the unscripted companion network; and GFam+, an app that lets viewers watch anytime, anywhere. Great American Media, established in June 2021 by Bill Abbott and a group of US-based family offices, is available via cable, streaming on Pure Flix and YouTube TV, and on the GFam+ app.

Pure Flix Familia is a soon-to-launch Spanish-language streaming platform featuring faith- and family-centered films, series, and original programming created for Latino audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling and collaborations with established and emerging Latino creators, Pure Flix Familia aims to become a trusted entertainment destination where families can discover uplifting stories that reflect their faith, values, and experiences.

releases.title: Qorvis Welcomes Veteran Media Executive Victor Shiblie
releases.body:
Washington Diplomat President and Publisher Brings More Than Three Decades of Media, International Business, and Diplomatic Experience to Qorvis

WASHINGTON, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Qorvis today announced that veteran media executive and international business strategist Victor Shiblie has joined the firm as Senior Advisor, bringing more than three decades of experience spanning media, international affairs, global business, and diplomatic engagement.

Shiblie joins Qorvis after a career at the center of Washington's diplomatic and international community. For more than 25 years, he has served as President and Publisher of The Washington Diplomat, one of the capital's leading publications serving the diplomatic community.

Under Shiblie's leadership, The Washington Diplomat built relationships across more than 180 foreign embassies, U.S. government institutions, multinational corporations, and international organizations. He also produced high-level policy forums, international conferences, and economic-development programs bringing together ambassadors, senior government officials, corporate executives, and international leaders.

"Victor understands the power of media, relationships and communications in international affairs because he has spent more than 30 years working at their intersection," said Matt Lauer, Chief Executive Officer of Qorvis. "Few people in Washington have built the breadth of relationships across the diplomatic, media and international business communities that Victor has. He brings extraordinary experience, judgment and connectivity to Qorvis and, most importantly, to our clients."

At Qorvis, Shiblie will advise clients on strategic communications, international business development, market access, and engagement with diplomatic, government, media, and business stakeholders, while helping expand the firm's international network and global business opportunities.

Beyond his media career, Shiblie has extensive experience in international trade and cross-border investment, including connecting investors, developers, government stakeholders and commercial partners on international energy and infrastructure opportunities. He has also advised foreign investors pursuing opportunities in the United States and foreign governments seeking to attract American investment and strengthen commercial ties with the United States.

"Qorvis has built a unique platform combining communications, geopolitical insight, international business, and access to decision-makers around the world," said Shiblie. "I am excited to join a team that understands how these disciplines increasingly intersect and to put my experience and relationships to work for Qorvis clients."

Earlier in his career, Shiblie led marketing and operations for KENO Electronics, an international import-export company serving government, embassy and commercial clients. He has also held civic and international leadership roles with organizations including the Ambassadors Ball Host Committee, Passport DC, the World Affairs Council, and the Arab American Business & Professional Association Institute.

Shiblie holds a B.B.A. in Marketing from Radford University and a certification in export management from the Government of the District of Columbia. He is conversant in Arabic.

About Qorvis 

Qorvis is a global advisory and strategic communications firm headquartered in Washington, D.C., with primary offices in Geneva, Brussels, and Dubai. Founded in 2000, Qorvis has guided multinational corporations, sovereign nations, ultra-high net worth individuals, and global institutions through every major global shift of the last 25 years. We serve clients in sectors of strategic importance: energy, aerospace and defense tech, critical minerals, healthcare and biopharma, and sovereign funds and state entities. Many operate in politically sensitive, legally complex, or reputationally exposed environments.

For more information, visit www.qorvis.com.

releases.title: Keyfactor Appoints Former CyberArk CEO Matt Cohen to Board of Directors and Strategic Advisor
releases.body:
Appointment comes as Keyfactor closes $1B+ growth investment led by Summit Partners and accelerates its next phase of scale beyond $200 million in ARR

ATLANTA and STOCKHOLM, Oct. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Keyfactor, the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, today announced the appointment of former CyberArk CEO Matt Cohen to its Board of Directors. Cohen will also serve as a strategic advisor to Keyfactor CEO Jordan Rackie, providing an additional source of perspective and operating experience as the company enters its next phase of growth and scale.

The appointment coincides with the closing of Keyfactor's previously announced $1 billion-plus growth investment led by Summit Partners and follows the company's recent milestone of surpassing $200 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR). Together, the developments reflect Keyfactor's continued growth and accelerate investment behind its Trust Control Plane and expand its leadership across machine identity, cryptography, AI security and post-quantum readiness.

Cohen most recently served as CEO of CyberArk, where he helped lead one of cybersecurity's defining growth stories and ultimately the company's approximately $25 billion acquisition by Palo Alto Networks. Over more than two decades in technology, Cohen has built and scaled global businesses, led major strategic and operational transformations, and created significant enterprise value. Before becoming CyberArk's CEO in 2023, he served as its Chief Revenue Officer and Chief Operating Officer. Earlier in his career, he held senior leadership roles at PTC, including Executive Vice President of Worldwide Field Operations, helping scale the company beyond $1 billion in ARR.

"As we began thinking about Keyfactor's next chapter with Summit and the rest of our Board, we were very intentional about the experience and perspective we wanted around the table," said Jordan Rackie, CEO of Keyfactor. "As our market opportunity continues to expand, we're entering a phase where scaling with ambition, discipline and operational rigor will be critical."

"Matt was someone we pursued very deliberately. He has operated at the scale we aspire to reach, helped build a category leader in cybersecurity and navigated many of the opportunities and inflection points that lie ahead for Keyfactor. We share similar values around leadership, transparency and how to approach both opportunities and challenges. He brings tremendous experience and judgment to our Board, and I'm equally excited to have him as a strategic and trusted advisor as we navigate Keyfactor's next phase of growth."

Keyfactor has emerged as a global leader at the intersection of machine identity and cryptography as enterprises confront an unprecedented expansion in the number of machines, workloads, applications and AI agents that must be authenticated and trusted. The company's Trust Control Plane represents the next evolution of how enterprises manage trust across these environments. It creates a unified control layer that brings together visibility, intelligence, policy and action across machine identity and cryptography.

"The most exciting companies are often positioned at the intersection of major technology shifts, and that's exactly where I believe Keyfactor sits today," said Cohen. "AI, machine identity, cryptographic modernization and the transition to post-quantum security are converging to create one of the most significant security challenges enterprises will face over the next decade."

"Keyfactor has meaningful scale, a strong culture and a clear vision for where the market is headed. From my early conversations with Jordan, we found a lot of common ground, and I saw a leader who's clear-eyed about what the next level of growth truly demands. I'm excited to join the Board, serve as a strategic advisor to Jordan and help the team capitalize on the tremendous opportunity ahead."

Summit Partners' investment provides additional resources to help accelerate Keyfactor's growth strategy, which focuses on continued product innovation, international expansion, strategic acquisitions and investment across the company's global organization. Cohen's appointment reflects a broader philosophy around preparing Keyfactor for its next phase: continuing to strengthen the leadership team while surrounding the company with Board members, advisors and partners who bring relevant experience from the scale Keyfactor intends to reach.

For more information, visit https://www.keyfactor.com/.

About Keyfactor

Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines. The platform equips enterprises to take control of the machine identities and cryptography that safeguard every digital interaction. By bringing fragmented tools and assets into a single control plane, security teams can see their cryptographic landscape, find and remediate risk exposure, roll out compliant and quantum-safe cryptography, and issue a cryptographic identity to every machine, workload and AI. Trusted by the largest enterprises and government agencies, Keyfactor delivers the resilient foundation organizations need to keep running uninterrupted in the AI and quantum era. Learn more at www.keyfactor.com or follow Keyfactor on LinkedIn.

releases.title: FOX NEWS MEDIA EXPANDS PODCAST PORTFOLIO WITH NEW ORIGINAL SHOW "the GIRLS" DEBUTING OCTOBER 1
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FOX News Podcasts will broaden its original podcast slate with FOX News' the Girls, a new personality-driven conversation series featuring an array of leading female voices. The announcement was made today by FOX News Digital and New Media President Porter Berry and Megan Albano, Executive Vice President of Morning Programming & Program Development. "the Girls" will debut on October 1st, with new episodes dropping every Thursday across all podcast platforms, including FOX News Digital, YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Podcasts.

Each episode of FOX News' the Girls will include a rotating cast of co-hosts week to week, moving beyond the traditional news roundtable for a free-flowing conversation that can go anywhere — politics and pop culture; money and marriage; parenting, relationships, careers, or the group chat-worthy story of the day. Nothing is off the table. Showcasing multiple distinct perspectives, the conversation will revolve naturally around the issues impacting real life with undeniable chemistry, refreshing candor and no script. The first episode will feature FOX News Media stars Rachel Campos-Duffy, Harris Faulkner and Kat Timpf, newly named FOX News contributor Melissa DeRosa and former ESPN host Samantha Ponder.

In commenting on the announcement, Berry said, "the Girls is a natural addition to our growing podcast portfolio, and we're thrilled to continue expanding our slate of distinctive shows that complement our existing lineup while creating new opportunities for our audience to engage with our content."

Albano added, "We're excited to deliver a no-holds-barred format that captures the authenticity and perspectives of the many dynamic women of FOX News Media and beyond."

Bringing together unique female voices and experiences spanning news, politics, sports, comedy and culture, the premiere episode will feature a variety of viewpoints and backgrounds:

  • Rachel Campos-Duffy joined FNC in 2016 and currently co-hosts FOX & Friends Weekend. A mother of nine, she is a New York Times bestselling author and previously appeared on MTV's The Real World.
  • Emmy Award-winning journalist Harris Faulkner has been with FNC since 2005 and anchors The Faulkner Focus and co-hosts Outnumbered. She is also a New York Times bestselling author and mother of two daughters.
  • Kat Timpf, who joined FNC in 2015, is a panelist on Gutfeld!, comedian and two-time New York Times bestselling author. A mother and breast cancer survivor, she has spoken candidly about motherhood, loss, and her cancer diagnosis.
  • Veteran democratic strategist Melissa DeRosa previously held several senior roles in former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo's administration, becoming the first woman to serve as secretary to the governor.
  • Samantha Ponder is a former host of ESPN's Sunday NFL Countdown and a mother of three children.

The new podcast is the latest addition to FOX News Media's new media division which features an established suite of podcasts including Hang Out with Sean Hannity, Ruthless, Will Cain Country, Planet Tyrus and The Riley Gaines Show. 

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Podcasts, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer streaming services FOX Nation, and FOX News International and the free ad-supported television service FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for over 24 consecutive years, while FBN is the top business channel on cable. FOX News Media reaches nearly 200 million people each month and is also available to live stream on FOX One.

releases.title: UNIVERSAL MUSIC GROUP APPOINTS ÒSCAR CELMA AS SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT, APPLIED AI AND MACHINE LEARNING
releases.body:
Former Spotify, Pandora/SiriusXM and Condé Nast executive brings more than two decades of expertise in AI, music discovery and personalization

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, today announced the appointment of Òscar Celma as Senior Vice President, Applied AI and Machine Learning, effective immediately.

A recognized expert in AI, machine learning and music recommendation, Celma has helped shape how people discover and experience music. At Spotify, he helped lead the development of AI-powered personalized listening experiences including AI DJ, Jam and Daylist, as well as personalization and discovery products used by hundreds of millions of listeners worldwide.

Celma will help lead the development and application of AI and machine learning across UMG's global operations, supporting UMG's labels, divisions and businesses. He will report to Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer.

Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer, said, "Òscar brings a unique blend of quantitative and product experience, deep expertise in AI, and a love of music. He's built teams that have delivered and knows how to turn data at scale into useful insights. With the breadth and depth of UMG's data, there's enormous potential for him to help our teams do more for our artists."

Celma said, "I've spent much of my career exploring how technology can serve artists, songwriters and music fans. It's an exciting time to join Universal Music Group, given its industry leadership in using AI to expand what's creatively and commercially possible. I look forward to working with Hannah and leaders across UMG to advance our AI and machine learning capabilities to support human artistry.

Most recently, Celma led Machine Learning and Product Analytics at Condé Nast. Previously, as Director of Engineering at Spotify, he led engineering teams responsible for new listening experiences. He also spent seven years at Pandora/SiriusXM in senior data science leadership roles, focused on machine learning, music discovery, and recommendation. Earlier in his career, he was a Senior Research Scientist at Gracenote and co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer of Barcelona-based BMAT Music Innovators.

Celma holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Digital Communication from Universitat Pompeu Fabra in Barcelona and is a widely published researcher in music information retrieval and recommendation systems. He is the author of the Springer-published book Music Recommendation and Discovery.

About Universal Music Group

At Universal Music Group, we exist to shape culture through the power of artistry. UMG is the world leader in music-based entertainment, with a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content. Featuring the most comprehensive catalogue of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMG identifies and develops artists and produces and distributes the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music in the world. Committed to artistry, innovation, and entrepreneurship, UMG fosters the development of services, platforms, and business models in order to broaden artistic and commercial opportunities for our artists and create new experiences for fans. For more information, visit www.universalmusic.com.

releases.title: Work With Your Handz Joins CertainPath Partner Network as Recruiting Partner for Home-Service Contractors
releases.body:
Partnership gives CertainPath members a specialized recruiting resource spanning field technicians through executive leadership

HAYMARKET, Va., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Work With Your Handz, a national workforce solutions firm serving skilled trades and service-driven organizations, today announced it has joined the CertainPath Partner Network as a recruiting partner for home-service contractors.

Contractors in the CertainPath network have built strong market positions and see real demand for their services, but growth stalls when they can't find or hire enough skilled people. CertainPath coaches work closely with member businesses and are often the first to recognize when recruiting, not demand, has become the limiting factor in a contractor's growth. Through this partnership, coaches can introduce Work With Your Handz as a specialized recruiting resource once that gap is identified.

"Many contractors have the demand and opportunity to grow, but they can't grow without the right people," said Kelly Rowlett Presgrave, Founder, President and CEO of Work With Your Handz. "We understand the skilled trades from the technician level through leadership, and this partnership gives CertainPath members another resource when hiring becomes a barrier to growth."

Work With Your Handz brings established experience in the industries CertainPath members serve, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical and related skilled trades. That familiarity allows the firm to support hiring across an entire organization, from field technicians and skilled-trades roles to managers, senior leadership and executive search.

A key differentiator for Work With Your Handz is its ability to communicate credibly across both ends of the home-services business. Because its recruiters have direct industry experience, they can ask the technical questions needed to determine whether a candidate genuinely has the skilled-trades background a client requires. That same team is equally comfortable working with owners, senior executives and private-equity-backed home-service organizations navigating growth and leadership transitions.

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Surfside, the advertising operating system built for the retail majority, today announced that Lars Djuvik has joined the company as Chief Revenue Officer.

Djuvik joins Surfside as the company expands the infrastructure it built in cannabis and alcohol into grocery, convenience and other retail categories. releases.title: Surfside Names Lars Djuvik Chief Revenue Officer as It Expands Retail Media Platform Beyond Cannabis and Alcohol
releases.body:
Former Crealytics and Pentaleap executive joins as Surfside expands its retail media platform across grocery, convenience and other fragmented retail categories.

NEW YORK, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Surfside, the advertising operating system built for the retail majority, today announced that Lars Djuvik has joined the company as Chief Revenue Officer.

Djuvik joins Surfside as the company expands the infrastructure it built in cannabis and alcohol into grocery, convenience and other retail categories. Together these make up the "retail majority": the thousands of independent, specialty and regional retailers that account for the majority of consumer spending.

As Chief Revenue Officer, Djuvik will lead Surfside's revenue organization across both sides of that network: expanding partnerships with retailers while scaling the demand organization serving agencies, suppliers and advertisers.

"Lars understands something fundamental about retail media: the merchant, the media and the transaction have to work together, all in service of the shopper," said Michael Blanche, co-CEO of Surfside. "He has spent his career on every side of that equation. As we take the infrastructure we built in some of the most complex retail environments and bring it to a much larger market, there are very few people with his combination of retailer, brand, agency and adtech experience."

Djuvik brings more than 25 years of experience across advertising, commerce and retail media. He most recently held leadership roles at Crealytics and Pentaleap, the retail media technology company launched by Crealytics. He also held leadership positions at Shopkick, acquired by SK Planet and now part of Trax Retail; Interactive Media Holdings, which became the publicly traded demand-side platform Viant; and Freeosk, whose in-store sampling platform has operated across major retailers including Sam's Club and Albertsons.

Surfside built its platform in two of the most heavily regulated categories: cannabis and alcohol. Its technology connects onsite, offsite and in-store media activation with transaction data and measurement at the source, allowing retailers and brands to evaluate performance against point-of-sale outcomes while retailers retain ownership of their customer and transaction data.

The company has been extending that infrastructure to regional grocers, convenience stores, liquor retailers, gas stations, specialty retailers and other businesses that have often been excluded from retail media because of fragmented point-of-sale systems, loyalty programs and data environments. Surfside enables these retailers to participate in a unified, addressable network while giving advertisers a more efficient way to reach and measure custom audiences.

While Surfside also partners with the largest retailers, its core mission is this underserved retail set, which accounts for roughly 80% of consumers' everyday shopping.

"Surfside doesn't get paid on impressions or guesses; it gets paid on performance tied directly to point-of-sale data," said Djuvik. "The cash register, not a click, is the source of truth. That is the standard I've chased throughout my career. Surfside has built the infrastructure to give the retail majority access to meaningful advertising demand without requiring them to hand over ownership of their customer relationships."

Djuvik said Surfside's ability to connect advertising with the moments when purchasing decisions are made was another factor in his decision to join.

"The greatest opportunity is often the day or two before an event, when customers are filling their carts or planning their everyday shopping," Djuvik added. "Surfside helps brands, and especially their agencies, understand and act on those high-value moments while giving retailers a direct role in the media economics surrounding their customers. What sealed it for me, though, wasn't just the technology. It's the team. This is a group of retail media and adtech operators who've actually built and scaled this from the ground up."

Surfside has already expanded into grocery and convenience, with additional retail categories to follow.

About Surfside

Surfside is the Advertising OS for the Retail Majority. One platform connects brands, retailers, and shoppers across every channel, built on purchase data from thousands of independent and regional stores that standard retail media fails to activate. Brands get high-intent audiences and inventory they cannot buy anywhere else. Retailers turn transactions they already process into revenue. Every campaign is measured against real sales.

MIAMI, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- WLRN Public Media today announced that Tom Hudson has been named Chief Executive Officer, following a nationwide search for the organization's next permanent leader. releases.title: WLRN PUBLIC MEDIA NAMES TOM HUDSON CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER FOLLOWING NATIONWIDE SEARCH
releases.body:
Veteran journalist and public media leader takes permanent helm of WLRN; Carlton Gillespie to succeed Hudson as host of The Florida Roundup as Hudson prepares to relaunch The Sunshine Economy this fall

MIAMI, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- WLRN Public Media today announced that Tom Hudson has been named Chief Executive Officer, following a nationwide search for the organization's next permanent leader. Hudson, who has been serving as Interim CEO, will now officially take the helm of one of South Florida's leading public media organizations.

The appointment marks a new chapter for WLRN — and a return to familiar territory for Hudson, whose career at the organization has spanned newsroom leadership, award-winning journalism, statewide public affairs programming and some of WLRN's most ambitious coverage of South Florida's economy.

"This is a critical time for public media and Tom has the right mix of journalistic integrity, collaboration and innovation to take WLRN into the future," said South Florida Public Media Group Board of Directors Chair Cheryl Wilke. 

As CEO, Hudson will lead WLRN's television, radio, digital, journalism and community engagement operations while helping shape the organization's strategy for reaching and serving audiences across a rapidly changing South Florida.

"WLRN has an extraordinary opportunity to build on the trust we have earned in South Florida while finding new ways to be essential to the communities we serve," said Hudson. "That means Florida-focused journalism, compelling local programming, meaningful community engagement and creating more opportunities for South Floridians to understand and participate in the issues shaping this region. I am incredibly proud of this organization, the community which supports it and excited about what we can build together."

Hudson has spent much of his career at the intersection of journalism, economics and public media. He previously served as WLRN's Vice President of News and later returned to the organization as Senior Economics Editor and Special Correspondent. Earlier in his career, he was managing editor and co-anchor of PBS' Nightly Business Report. At WLRN, he also helped create and host programs that became fixtures for audiences across South Florida and the state.

With his move into the permanent CEO role, Hudson will step down as host of The Florida Roundup, WLRN's weekly statewide public affairs program covering the politics, economy, environment, culture and news shaping Florida.

WLRN Broward County Bureau Reporter Carlton Gillespie will take over as host of The Florida Roundup. Gillespie began his career at WLRN as an intern and has grown into one of the newsroom's recognizable voices, most recently covering Broward County and regularly contributing to The Florida Roundup as a reporter, expert guest and fill-in host. His appointment represents another important step in WLRN's commitment to developing journalistic talent from within the organization. Gillespie's journalism recently was recognized with a national Edward R. Murrow award.

Hudson, however, will not be leaving the microphone entirely.

This fall, he plans to bring back The Sunshine Economy, the signature WLRN program he created and hosted for a decade exploring the people, businesses, industries and economic forces transforming South Florida.

The program, which originally ran from 2013 to 2023, took listeners beyond economic statistics to tell the stories of the people behind them — from entrepreneurs and CEOs to workers, policymakers and community leaders — while examining issues ranging from housing and tourism to technology, climate change, employment and the region's evolving business landscape.

Hudson will once again serve as host when The Sunshine Economy returns to WLRN radio and podcast audiences this fall.

And its return will begin with a live conversation about where South Florida's economy is headed next.

On September 23, Hudson will host and moderate the WLRN Sunshine Economy Summit 2026, a major gathering of business leaders, policymakers, community experts and other key stakeholders examining the opportunities and challenges defining South Florida's economic future. Gillespie and WLRN Palm Beach County Reporter Wilkine Brutus will also serve as panel moderators.

Hudson hopes to use the Summit as a launching point for the next chapter of The Sunshine Economy, turning the conversations taking place on stage into the beginning of a renewed, ongoing dialogue with South Florida audiences.

"The economy touches virtually every part of our lives — where we live, how we work, what we earn, how our communities grow and what kind of South Florida we are building for the future," Hudson said. "There has never been a more interesting or important time to tell those stories. The Sunshine Economy Summit gives us an opportunity to bring people together around those questions, and I'm looking forward to carrying that conversation back to our listeners this fall."

Hudson's appointment comes at a pivotal moment for WLRN as the organization continues to expand its reach, deepen its local journalism and strengthen its connection with audiences and communities throughout South Florida.

His new role brings together the different chapters of his WLRN career — journalist, host, newsroom leader and executive — around a single mission: ensuring WLRN remains the beacon of trusted journalism, storytelling, culture and public service for the region it calls home.

About WLRN Public Media

WLRN Public Media is an award-winning public media organization serving South Florida through radio, television and digital platforms. Through independent journalism, educational programming, original storytelling, arts and cultural content and community engagement, WLRN connects audiences throughout Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Monroe counties and beyond with the information and programming that help them better understand their communities and the world.

releases.title: SiriusXM Names Sean Gibbons Chief Product and Technology Officer
releases.body:
Longtime SiriusXM leader will advance the Company's product experiences and technology strategy 

NEW YORK, Sept. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SiriusXM (NASDAQ: SIRI) today announced that Sean Gibbons has been promoted to Senior Vice President, Chief Product and Technology Officer, reporting to Chief Executive Officer Jennifer Witz and joining the Company's Executive Leadership Team. In this role, Gibbons will lead product and technology across SiriusXM and Pandora, with responsibility for product strategy and development, technology platforms and engineering, automotive and streaming distribution partnerships, and advertising technology.

"Sean has helped shape SiriusXM through some of our most important product and technology transformations, including the development and successful rollout of SiriusXM with 360L," said Jennifer Witz, Chief Executive Officer, SiriusXM. "He brings more than two decades of experience, deep knowledge of our business and a strong track record of bringing together teams, technology and partnerships to deliver for consumers. Sean is a highly respected leader and the right person to help us accelerate innovation, improve the customer experience and advance the products, platforms and partnerships that will support our growth."

Gibbons' key priorities will include advancing SiriusXM with 360L and the Company's next generation of in-car experiences; shaping the long-term technology roadmap supporting SiriusXM's satellite, broadcast and streaming platforms; applying AI to improve personalization, discovery and customer service; and creating more dynamic, connected and participatory experiences across SiriusXM's in-vehicle and streaming platforms.

"SiriusXM has a unique set of assets and a tremendous opportunity to make them work together even more powerfully for listeners," said Gibbons. "We can pair the reach and reliability of satellite with the flexibility of streaming and the intelligence of AI to make it easier for people to discover what they love, stay connected wherever they listen and participate more deeply in the content and moments that matter to them. I'm excited to take on this role and help shape the next generation of the SiriusXM experience."

Gibbons joined Sirius in 2000, before the company's first satellite launch, and has held leadership roles spanning product management, engineering, automotive, streaming, content technology and strategic partnerships. During his tenure, he established SiriusXM's first formal Product Management organization and later founded and led its first Streaming organization, expanding the SiriusXM experience across mobile, web and connected-home platforms.

Most recently, Gibbons led SiriusXM's Automotive organization, bringing together product, user experience, engineering and automotive partnerships to advance the company's in-vehicle experiences and relationships with leading automakers. Across more than two decades at SiriusXM, he has played a central role in many of the Company's most significant product and technology transformations, including its evolution toward connected, software-defined vehicle experiences and hybrid satellite-and-IP services.

About Sirius XM Holdings Inc.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, with a portfolio of audio businesses including its flagship subscription entertainment service SiriusXM; the ad-supported and premium music streaming services of Pandora; an expansive podcast network; and a complete ecosystem of advertising solutions through SiriusXM Media and AdsWizz. SiriusXM offers live, on-demand, and human-curated programming across music, talk, news, sports, and podcasts, and the company reaches approximately 255 million monthly listeners across its platforms. With deep automotive manufacturer relationships and unique spectrum assets, SiriusXM is built to reach listeners wherever they are. The company connects fans to the voices, creators, and moments they love - creating communities where listeners engage, participate, and belong. For more about SiriusXM, please go to: https://www.siriusxm.com/

releases.title: Vobile Signs Strategic Cooperation and Commercial Agreements with UNN to Build AI Factories in Brunei Darussalam
releases.body:
SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vobile, a global leader in digital content protection and transaction services, has signed strategic cooperation and commercial agreements with Unified National Networks Sdn Bhd (UNN), an integrated national telecommunication network operator of Brunei Darussalam.

Christopher Phan, Acting Chief Executive Officer of UNN, and Yangbin Wang, Chief Executive Officer of Vobile, Inc., signed the agreements at a ceremony held at UNN's Tungku Submarine Cable Landing Station on September 3, 2026. The ceremony was witnessed by Yang Mulia Haji Hairul Mohd Daud bin Haji Abd Karim, Deputy Permanent Secretary (Infocommunications), Ministry of Transport and Infocommunications, and UNN Board Director.

"The development of AI-ready infrastructure is of critical importance, not only for our two organizations but also for the future growth of Brunei's digital economy," said Heiko Trost, Chief Digital Officer of UNN, at the signing ceremony. "We view this relationship with Vobile as far more than a conventional customer-provider engagement. We see it as a partnership built on shared ambition, innovation and mutual success. Together, we have the opportunity to create meaningful value for Brunei, strengthen the nation's digital capabilities, and explore new opportunities across the region."

"DreamMaker helps film and television studios, independent producers and creators use AI technologies to create video entertainment while protecting their intellectual property and finding new ways to generate revenue from their work. This is especially important as AI transforms the global creative industry," said Ben Smith, Executive Vice President of Vobile. "By combining UNN's infrastructure with Vobile's AI capabilities, we can help establish Brunei as a leading AI economy in Southeast Asia while delivering sustainable economic growth for the nation."

UNN's new AI-capable data center, designed with liquid cooling and high power density to support NVIDIA's latest GPU systems, will allocate 25MW of capacity to Vobile. An additional 25MW is reserved for Vobile's future expansion. This enables Vobile to run AI factories that scale its DreamMaker platform and related services to meet growing demand from clients including film and television studios, independent producers, and content creators.

About Vobile

Vobile is the global leader in digital content protection and transaction services, trusted by the world's premier entertainment companies, platforms, music labels, sports leagues, and publishers. Using AI technologies, Vobile's solutions make creative content more valuable. Founded in Silicon Valley, Vobile has operations across North America, Asia, Australia, and Europe. For more information, visit www.vobile.com.
